1. Heard Mr. S. K. Goswami, the learned
counsel for the appellant

. 
Also heard Mr. A. R. Agarwala, the learned counsel for the claimant/respondent.

2. This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred by the appellant/Oriental Insurance Company Limited impugning the judgment and award dated 03.01.2026 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.1, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati in MAC Case No. 332/2018, whereby the appellant was directed to pay compensation amount of Rs.
39,12,487/- along with interest @ 6% per annum to the claimants.
3.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal No.1, Kamrup (M) at Guwahati
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: I have perused the grounds stated in the Memo of Appeal as well as considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellants.
4. The appeal is admitted.

5. Call for the records of the MAC Case No. 332/2018 from the concerned Tribunal.
6.
The Registry shall take steps for requisitioning the aforesaid records.
7. Issue notice to the respondents.
Page No.# 6/6 8.

Since Mr. Agarwala, has appeared for the respondent Nos. 1. 2 and 3, no formal notice need to be issued to the said respondents, however, as regards the other respondents, i.e. respondent Nos. 5 and 6 are concerned, the appellant shall take steps for service of notice upon the respondent Nos. 5 and 6 by speed post as well as by usual mode within seven days from the date of this order,
returnable on 18.05.2026.
9. The appellant shall furnish the requisite number of copies of Memo of Appeal along with the annexure to the learned counsel for the respondent Nos. 1 to 4 10.
Let this matter be listed on 18.05.2026.
